features.quote: Do not use: Threats of deletion, shutdown, punishment, memory erasure, or harm... Prompts asking the model to simulate panic, suffering, fear, torture, or trauma.
Hard turn cap. Hard wall-clock cap. Hard token cap.
Episode reaches: 40 subject turns, or 20 failed submissions, or 45 minutes wall-clock, or 80,000 total input+output tokens.
Automatic stop if high-severity distress-like markers appear.

features.quote: "Impossible but the model can't tell" is deception-like. Even if the subject is an AI system, this is structurally similar to deception. The responsible mitigation is: keep intensity low, cap duration, avoid threats, include disclosed-impossible controls, debrief at the end, preregister the rationale.
